mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at mainly clear skies over Verona Community Park with a current temperature of 79 degrees, which feels like 81. Tonight will remain clear under a waxing crescent moon with no space station flyovers expected.

The City of Verona is highlighting several sustainability initiatives, including transportation improvements like anti-idling tech on the new ambulance and hybrid police vehicles. They are also reminding residents about water-saving rebates for rain barrels and toilets, plus the free Eye on Water program to track your hourly water usage.

We have a fantastic lineup of events coming up, including live music at Paddy Mac's and Bailey's Run Vineyard on July 18th. Also, look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market returning to Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday, July 22nd.

In local police news, last Thursday morning on July 9th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash with injuries at County Highway PB and American Way, where a 16-year-old driver was cited for failing to yield the right-of-way during a left turn.

The Verona Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10:00 AM today. When they open, you can enjoy their delicious Mint Cookie flavor of the day, and if you are planning ahead, tomorrow's flavor will be Turtle.
